- Used `git credential store` at `/tmp/git-creds` with PAT to push to GitHub after direct URL auth failed
- Created clean branch `deploy-worker-fix` from `github/main` to avoid rebase conflicts with Rork history files
- Campaign cycle runs automatically — no manual trigger needed; boot kick + 5-min interval in `server.ts` handles enqueueing

- Wait for next campaign cycle (boot kick or 5-min interval) to re-queue specialists
